description: Angular component for entity details page in Thingsboard UI, managing entity display, editing, deletion, and navigation.

classes.name: EntityDetailsPageComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending EntityDetailsPanelComponent, managing entity details display, editing, deletion, and navigation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up subscriptions for route parameters and entity actions.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads entity data and updates UI.

methods.name: onToggleDetailsEditMode
methods.description: Toggles between view and edit modes for entity details.

methods.name: onApplyDetails
methods.description: Saves changes to entity and updates UI.

methods.name: confirmForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for confirmation.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Confirms and deletes the specified entity, then navigates back.
